purpose: Every hero power in the mashup. One row = one RDZ_AbilityDef in generated code. Numbers are DayZ-scale design values; the launcher reads each ability's real name and description from the player's Marvel Rivals install and shows them in game.

rivals_match.doc: English ability name as it appears in Marvel Rivals; the launcher looks it up in the player's Rivals text files.

power_bit.doc: Bit in the player's synced power mask.

range_m.doc: swing: max web length; crawl: wall detect distance; zip/web_shot: aim range; area_drain: radius.

damage.doc: web_shot/zip_yank: hit damage; drain_melee: extra drain damage per hit; area_drain: damage per second.

duration_s.doc: web_shot: time a target stays webbed; area_drain: drain time before the pull; mimicry: how long stolen powers last.

speed_mps.doc: crawl: crawl speed; zip_yank: travel speed; area_drain: pull speed.

heal_pct.doc: Percent of drained damage returned to Rogue as health.

stealable.doc: Rogue's Mimicry takes this power when she hits its owner.

number_source.doc: design = tuned for DayZ health scale; rivals = read from the player's Rivals files.
